title: Interpolation results
description: The file `q3_utility interpolate` writes: <outdir>/<prefix>_interpolation_results.json, the evaluation of a saved interpolation record along a k-point list and, when asked, on a dense mesh for a density of states. `required` is the PRODUCER's guarantee — present in every file the utility writes. It is not a reader's precondition: the Python model (q3.io.interpolation_results) defaults every field to None, because the unit-test stub and older files carry a subset. The keys q3.workflows.wannier adds after the evaluation (quality.status, quality.reason, quality.ladder, quality.band_distance) are optional here, so one schema describes the file before and after the workflow annotates it. Units are carried in the key names: bohr and bohr squared for the Wannier geometry, rydberg for energies, electronvolts where the manifest speaks them.

calculation.description: Always "interpolation": the calculation this file is the result of.

provenance.description: The provenance stamp of the evaluated manifest, carried through as it stands; its shape is the SCF results file's (docs/io_reference.md, section 4.1) and is not described again here.

fermi_energy_ry.description: The Fermi level the NSCF that built the record computed over its own full-grid k-set, in rydberg — the highest occupied level when every requested band is occupied. q3.workflows.interpolation reports the SCF's value instead, which is the authoritative one.

kpoints.description: Crystal coordinates of the evaluated k-points, one [k1, k2, k3] each; present when bands were evaluated.

eigenvalues_ry.description: The interpolated eigenvalues shaped [k-point][spin][band] in rydberg, as the SCF results file shapes them so the Python extractors read both unchanged; present with kpoints.

density_of_states.title: Interpolation results density of states
density_of_states.description: The interpolated density of states on control.interpolation.dos_mesh; present when a mesh was asked for.

mesh.description: The dense mesh the eigenvalues were interpolated on, [n1, n2, n3].

broadening_ry.description: The gaussian broadening applied, in rydberg (control.dos_broadening).

dos.description: States per rydberg per cell, spin included, one per energy.

interpolation.title: Interpolation results interpolation
interpolation.description: The model that was evaluated: how it was built, how big it is, and what it says about itself.

description.description: How the model was built, in words: the method, the subspace choice, whether and how far the gauge was localised, and the model's size.

record.description: The path of the record that was evaluated.

number_of_bands.description: The number of bands the model interpolates: the number of Wannier functions.

total_bloch_sum_weight.description: The Wigner-Seitz weight identity: the sum of the Bloch-sum weights over the model's lattice vectors, which equals the number of k-points of the mesh the record was built on.

diagnostics.description: Any further diagnostic the interpolator reports, by name. The local-orbital interpolator reports none beyond total_bloch_sum_weight, which has its own key because readers and the reference name it.

spread.title: Interpolation results spread
spread.description: The Marzari-Vanderbilt spread of the model's Wannier functions at the gauge it was built with, in bohr and bohr squared. Omega_I is reported always; the rest whenever the record carries the neighbour overlaps that define it and the mesh has no two-point axis — the projection gauge has a spread too, and a driver comparing two models wants it either way.

gauge_invariant_bohr_squared.description: Omega_I: the part of the spread the gauge cannot change. From the spread when it was evaluated, otherwise from the subspace iteration when there was one; zero for an isolated manifold without overlaps.

localized.description: Whether the gauge was rotated by the spread minimiser at all.

total_bohr_squared.description: Omega = Omega_I + Omega_D + Omega_OD at the final gauge.

guiding_centers.description: What fixed the branch of each Berry phase: "trial orbitals" when the record carries their positions, "projection gauge" otherwise.

trial_orbital_centers_bohr.description: The record's trial-orbital positions, Cartesian bohr, one [x, y, z] per function; empty when it carries none.

initial_minimizable_bohr_squared.description: Omega_D + Omega_OD at the projection gauge, before any rotation: what localisation bought is this minus the final value.

centers_bohr.description: The Wannier centres at the final gauge, Cartesian bohr, one [x, y, z] per function.

spreads_bohr_squared.description: Omega_n per function: <r^2>_n - |<r>_n|^2, summing to the total.

localization_iterations.description: How many iterations the spread minimiser ran; present when it ran.

localization_converged.description: Whether the minimiser reached a stationary gauge rather than merely stopped; false after a stall, where the gauge is the best one found but not a minimum.

localization_gradient_norm.description: The norm of the spread gradient where the minimiser stopped, a diagnostic beside the answer rather than the convergence test.

disentanglement.title: Interpolation results disentanglement
disentanglement.description: What the classifier decided when the subspace was chosen by projectability disentanglement: the window it resolved and which bands the singular-gauge rule kept out of the freeze. Present only when the model was disentangled.

metallic.description: Whether a band crosses the Fermi level, which is what makes the automatic window E_F + 2 eV rather than 0.

bands_crossing_fermi.description: How many bands cross the Fermi level.

frozen_window_above_fermi_ev.description: The frozen window that was applied, in electronvolts above the Fermi level.

frozen_window_automatic.description: Whether the window was resolved from the record (true) or given in the manifest (false).

bands_excluded_from_freeze.description: Bands inside the frozen window whose projectability fell below the minimum at some k-points, and were excluded from the freeze there rather than frozen: the trial orbitals cannot represent them, and freezing them would make the gauge singular.

band.description: The band, one-based as the manifest counts them.

kpoints.description: At how many k-points it was excluded.

quality.title: Interpolation results quality
quality.description: What the model says about itself with no reference calculation, and — added afterwards by q3.workflows.wannier, which runs the calculation they need — the band distance against a direct one and the verdict it earned.

spread.title: Interpolation results quality spread
spread.description: Statistics of the per-function spreads; present when a spread was evaluated.

variance_bohr_squared.description: The population variance of the spreads across functions: the published no-reference criterion.

outliers.description: Zero-based indices of functions above five times the median.

above_ten_angstrom_squared.description: Zero-based indices of functions whose spread exceeds ten square angstrom, whatever the others do.

centers.title: Interpolation results quality centers
centers.description: The Wannier centres against the atoms of the manifest's material, over periodic images; present when a spread was evaluated and the manifest names atoms.

nearest_atom_distance_bohr.description: Per function, the distance to the nearest atom.

nearest_bond_midpoint_distance_bohr.description: Per function, the distance to the nearest midpoint of a bond.

shortest_bond_bohr.description: The shortest interatomic distance, which defines a bond here as anything within 20 percent of it.

hamiltonian_decay.title: Interpolation results hamiltonian decay
hamiltonian_decay.description: How far H(R) has decayed by the edge of its Wigner-Seitz domain. A Bloch sum that has not decayed by its last term is the direct cause of error between mesh points.

outermost_shell_distance_bohr.description: |R| of the outermost shell of lattice vectors.

outermost_shell_size.description: How many lattice vectors share that distance.

outermost_shell_maximum_ry.description: The largest Bloch-sum term w_R |H_mn(R)| on that shell.

largest_hopping_ry.description: The largest term that varies with k: any R away from the origin, or m != n on site, so a rigid shift of the energy zero cannot move it.

ratio.description: outermost_shell_maximum_ry / largest_hopping_ry; zero when there is nothing to divide by.

localization_converged.description: Repeated from spread.localization_converged when the gauge was minimised, so the block a driver judges by is complete on its own.

status.description: Added by q3.workflows.wannier: "accept" or "reject", the verdict of the retry ladder on this model.

reason.description: Added by q3.workflows.wannier: why the verdict was reached, in words.

ladder.description: Added by q3.workflows.wannier: every evaluation the retry ladder made of the saved record, in order, ending with the one this file describes.

rung.description: The rung of the ladder that made the attempt: "default", "unconverged", "stalled", "window", "thresholds" or "mesh".

grid.description: The k-mesh of the record the attempt evaluated.

settings.description: The control.interpolation keys the attempt changed from the defaults, as it wrote them; for the mesh rung, the spacing it recaptured at (kpoint_spacing_inverse_angstrom).

status.description: What became of the attempt: "accept" or "retry" for an evaluation the gate judged, "error:<route>" for one that raised (the route is "unconverged", "localization", "infeasible" or "unknown", from the engine's diagnostic code), and "recapture" for the mesh rung, which evaluates nothing.

reason.description: Why, in words: the gate's verdict or the engine's own error line.

eta_ev.description: The band distance of the attempt, in electronvolts; null when the evaluation raised.

eta_maximum_ev.description: The largest pointwise band difference of the attempt, in electronvolts; null when the evaluation raised.

localized.description: Whether the attempt's gauge was localised; null when the evaluation raised.

localization_converged.description: Whether that localisation converged; null when the evaluation raised or did not localise.

band_distance.title: Interpolation results band distance
band_distance.description: Added by q3.workflows.wannier: the band distance of this model against a direct calculation on the reference k-points.

eta_ev.description: The band distance eta, in electronvolts.

eta_maximum_ev.description: The largest pointwise band difference, in electronvolts.

number_of_states.description: How many (k-point, band) pairs entered the distance.

reference.description: What the reference k-points were: "path" or "half-shifted mesh".

number_of_kpoints.description: How many reference k-points were compared.
